cancelled_withdrawal_amount.meaning: HYPE value (totalHypeValueReturned) recorded in _cancelledWithdrawalAmount when the user cancels the withdrawal request

redelegated_amount.meaning: HYPE amount actually re-delegated through _distributeStake with SpotDeposit during redelegateWithdrawnHYPE

stranded_amount.meaning: HYPE value left in the StakingManager contract outside totalStaked, hypeBuffer and delegation, permanently unusable by protocol or users

assumptions: The cancelled withdrawal HYPE amount is the full value that must be accounted for (delegated, buffered, or tracked) after re-delegation.
The stranded remainder is claimed to be permanently unrecoverable by the protocol or users, per the report's 'permanently stranded' wording.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the stranded remainder sits in the contract's ETH balance or an L1 account, so the exact storage location of stranded_amount cannot be bound.
Permanent lock and accumulation are described as potential/accumulating rather than observed in a concrete transaction; the conservation relation is asserted at the per-call amount level.

limitations: Conservation is formalized per re-delegation call; accumulation across many cancel-and-redelegate operations is not separately modeled.
The stranded_amount symbol is bound to the report's claim of permanent stranding; whether any admin recovery path exists is not established by the report.
